pages.text: Video: Watch Mac Ayres Play A Tiny Desk From Home : NPR Accessibility links Skip to main content Keyboard shortcuts for audio player Video: Watch Mac Ayres Play A Tiny Desk From Home The Long Island R&B singer premieres a new song during his Tiny Desk quarantine concert. Mac Ayres: Tiny Desk (Home) Concert November 30, 2020 5:00 AM ET Bobby Carter Credit: Courtesy of the Artist The Tiny Desk is working from home for the foreseeable future. Introducing NPR Music's Tiny Desk (home) concerts, bringing you performances from across the country and the world. It's the same spirit — stripped-down sets, an intimate setting — just a different space. "Tiny Desk! We finally made it!" exclaimed singer-songwriter Mac Ayres as he finished his opening number, "She Won't Stay Long." I'm sure his fans will especially feel that sentiment since they've made a home in our social media feeds and YouTube comments for years now. We were well on the way to hosting Mac Ayres at our D.C. offices until we had to shut down and pivot. As we worked our way through the adjustment to Tiny Desk (home) concerts, he also needed some time to regroup. Sponsor Message The 23-year-old Long Island native shot this in his basement back in September (hence the 'register to vote' comment). Mac's modus operandi lends itself to the Tiny Desk naturally. No over-produced beats, lots of live instruments and a stunning vocal range — and he handles all duties: guitar, bass, keyboard and background harmonies for three songs from previous albums and the premiere of a new song, "Sometimes." Wow. SET LIST "She Won't Stay Long"

By the time American forces withdrew from the conflict in 1973, more than 58,000 American lives were lost. Today the Vietnam Veterans Memorial on the National Mall in Washington, DC, honors the American men and women who served. It’s a raw January night in the old Shetland town of Lerwick, but there’s euphoria in the air. Beside me, a man with two young children laughs as he spots a red smoky haze rising behind the town hall. “Looks like they torched the whole building,” he shouts, to grins all around. pages.text: Vinicius Jr: Real Madrid forward says transfer interest has affected form - BBC Sport Image source, Getty Images Image caption, Vinicius Jr signed a new six-year contract with Real Madrid in August By Marissa Thomas BBC Sport journalist Published 16 November 2026 Real Madrid forward Vinicius Jr says he felt "truly overwhelmed" by transfer speculation in the summer, which has contributed to his mixed form at the start of the season. The Brazil international has scored just once and provided three assists in 12 appearances for Jose Mourinho's side this season. He was linked with a move to Premier League champions Arsenal this summer as he entered the final year of his contract, before signing an extension at Real. The 26-year-old also says he did not train as much as he should have following Brazil's last-16 exit at the World Cup. "I don't think I prepared as well as I could have after the World Cup, because the impact of that tournament is so significant for all Brazilians," he said. "Being knocked out so early was something we hadn't expected. So, I took advantage of my holidays to enjoy myself, rest, relax, and spend more time with my family. I ended up training less than in previous years. "That may have affected my start to the season. "On top of that, regarding my contract renewal, with so many clubs showing interest last summer, I felt truly overwhelmed, as with the situation at Real Madrid. But it's a very long season." Más de 600 personas mueren cada día a consecuencia de la violencia con armas de fuego, una violencia impulsada en parte por la facilidad con la que se accede —de forma legal o ilegal— a dichas armas. La violencia con armas de fuego puede afectar a cualquier persona, pero a menudo repercute de forma desproporcionada en las personas de color/racializadas, los hombres y niños de comunidades desfavorecidas , y otros grupos marginados. La violencia de género intrafamiliar que implica armas de fuego pone además a las mujeres en un mayor peligro de morir o de sufrir heridas que les cambian la vida. En ocasiones, la mera presencia de armas de fuego puede hacer que la gente se sienta amenazada o tema por su vida. Puede provocar que tenga miedo de asistir a la escuela o a centros de salud . La violencia con armas de fuego en el ámbito comunitario puede impedir el funcionamiento pleno de los servicios, lo que a su vez puede perjudicar al acceso a la educación o la atención médica. La gran mayoría de la violencia con armas de fuego ocurre fuera de los entornos de conflicto armado . Las bandas criminales golpean en la zona metropolitana de Puerto Príncipe y sus alrededores sembrando el terror y la violencia, con actos que incluyen la violación y otras formas de violencia sexual. Durante años, el país ha luchado con la inestabilidad política, la pobreza y los desastres naturales. Sin embargo, la escalada de la violencia de bandas ha empujado a Haití a una nueva era de inseguridad, en la que las bandas criminales ahora controlan la mayor parte de la capital, Puerto Príncipe. Las consecuencias de esta crisis en los derechos humanos son abrumadoras. Según se ha informado, más de 5.600 personas han muerto en el caos de Haití en 2024. La infancia es el blanco de las bandas criminales, a la que explotan de forma habitual. Casi cada calle podría convertirse en un campo de batalla. La comida escasea y la mitad de la población sufre hambre aguda . May 15, 2024 Español Vision Loss and Diabetes What to know Diabetes can damage your eyes over time and cause vision loss or blindness. Managing your diabetes can help to prevent or delay eye problems. Regular eye exams help to diagnose eye problems early so you can get treatment and protect your eyesight. Diabetic retinopathy Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is the leading cause of blindness in working-age adults. DR is when high blood sugar damages blood vessels in the retina (a part of your eye). Damaged blood vessels can swell and leak, causing blurry vision. DR usually affects both eyes. Diabetes can damage the small blood vessels at the back of the eyes, leading to vision loss. Risk factors Anyone with type 1, type 2, or gestational diabetes (diabetes while pregnant) can develop DR. The longer you have diabetes, the more likely you are to develop it. These factors can also increase your risk: High blood sugar, blood pressure, and cholesterol levels. Smoking. Being an African American, Hispanic/Latino, or American Indian or Alaska Native person. pages.text: Visit Kuélap, a Peruvian Archaeological Site a Millennium Older Than Machu Picchu | National Geographic TRAVEL BEST OF THE WORLD Visit Kuélap, a Peruvian Archaeological Site a Millennium Older Than Machu Picchu The remote region north of Lima is also a paradise for lovers of mummies, wildlife, and orchids. At more than 2,500 feet, the Gocta waterfall, near the village of Cocachimba in northern Peru, is one of the world’s tallest. Ernesto Benavides By Heather Jasper Published October 20, 2026 Although the pre-Incan fortress of Kuélap is almost a thousand years older than Machu Picchu, it gets only a fraction of the crowds. The Chachapoya people built the citadel in northern Peru around the year 500 A.D. on a narrow fin of limestone high above the Utcubamba River—not unlike Machu Picchu’s perch above the Vilcanota River. Visit in 2027 to see new exhibits in the Apu Chuillaxa visitors’ center and walk a new trail in Malcapampa , an active archaeological site that has been newly opened to the public. ( See all 25 of the destinations that made our list of the best places to visit in 2027. ) When to Go The warm, rainy season arrives in the cloud forests of this part of Peru in November and lasts until April. More than a thousand orchid species are in bloom and the waterfalls thunder with extra volume. A cooler dry season from May through October offers better road conditions and drier trails, making it easier to visit archaeological sites around Kuélap. From Rembrandt’s Night Watch and Vermeer's Milkmaid to masterpieces by Frans Hals, Vincent van Gogh, and Jan Steen, this is where Dutch history comes to life. It is a federal workplace, the setting for oral arguments, and a space where visitors from all over the world can come to learn more about the judicial branch of the United States and the nation’s highest Court. The Supreme Court Building is open Monday to Friday from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. It is closed on weekends and all federal holidays. Admission is free. Visitors should be aware that the business of the Court may affect public access to the building and visitor programs. Please check Today at the Court on the homepage for the Court’s daily calendar. Visitors may view the public portions of the building on a self-guided basis and take advantage of a variety of educational programs, including Courtroom Lectures , and Court-related Exhibitions . Court sessions, including the handing down of opinions, are also open to the public. See Oral Arguments for more information. pages.text: Visitor photography at the National Gallery | Visiting | The National Gallery, London Skip to main content Photography is allowed for personal, non-commercial purposes in the National Gallery. It is the visitor’s responsibility to ensure no copyright is infringed. There are a few exceptions to protect paintings, copyright of loans, individual privacy and the overall visitor experience. Exceptions Photography/filming is permitted in exhibitions for personal non-commercial use, unless otherwise stated on the label by the exhibited work. Use of additional lighting or flash, tripods, and selfie sticks is not permitted Photography of some loan paintings in the main galleries may be restricted, as indicated by signs beside the paintings Photography of children and young people is prohibited without consent of the accompanying adult. This includes, for example, school groups and/or those attending family events. Please respect the wishes of all visitors by not obstructing the view of the paintings or taking pictures of anyone without their permission. The National Gallery recognises its responsibility to safeguard the welfare of all children, young people and adults at risk. For more information read our Visitor Admissions Policy.

Here’s what the experts say about vitamin A and E. By Daryl Austin Last updated April 2, 2025 Vitamins and supplements are a booming industry. And while there are many important supplements that benefit people with specific deficiencies or certain health conditions, research shows and experts agree that some synthetic vitamins could cause harms such as liver damage, hair loss, joint and muscle pain, and impaired vision. "Everyone is always searching for that magic pill that will give them great health, but dietary supplements just aren't it because the benefits often don't outweigh the risks," says JoAnn Manson, chief of preventive medicine at Brigham and Women's Hospital in Boston, Massachusetts. pages.text: Vladimir Guerrero Jr.'s single hits piece of broken bat Skip to Content Talk about getting the barrel on it. Blue Jays first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. technically squared up his RBI single in the seventh inning of Friday's 6-5 win over the Reds at Rogers Centre, but he did it in quite an unusual way. On an 0-2 sinker from Cincinnati reliever Luis Mey, Guerrero chopped a ground ball toward the middle, breaking his bat in the process. Then, pure baseball magic took over. Slow-motion replay showed exactly what happened: The severed barrel of Guerrero's bat connected with the baseball several feet in front of home plate, redirecting the ball toward the right side of the infield. It rolled through a hole in the Reds' defense and into right field for a single, scoring Andrés Giménez from second base. Guerrero's hit, which brought in the first run of a pivotal four-run seventh to give Toronto the lead and eventually the win, was far from the first base hit on which a player hit the ball twice. In fact, it was at least the sixth this season -- including two on the same day. While it surely wasn't the hard contact Guerrero envisioned, Friday's double-hit allowed him to "hit 'em where they ain't" in a truly ingenious way.

Voices of Experience The Office of Electricity (OE) pioneered the Voices of Experience (Voices) approach more than a decade ago in response to industry feedback. The Voices efforts convene stakeholders to facilitate peer-to-peer sharing, with conversations focused on technologies and emerging issues facing industry. By actively listening to these conversations, OE gains a greater understanding of how technologies and concepts are being implemented and deployed, helping to identify gaps or barriers that can hinder progress. A Unique Approach The Voices of Experience approach is unique from other DOE stakeholder engagement efforts. It uses the art of the question and a structured approach that is centered on open dialogue and active listening to gather firsthand insights. Discussions include a mix of multi-stakeholder and single-stakeholder conversations, allowing for cross-pollination of ideas as well as safe spaces for more candid discussions. Convenings enable greater collaboration between stakeholders and, using Chatham House Rule governance, enables candor, allowing Voices efforts to identify gaps, share best practices, and uncover challenges that may not surface in other settings. Voltaire was a prolific writer and produced works in almost every literary form including plays, poetry, novels, essays, historical and scientific works, more than 20,000 letters and more than 2,000 books and pamphlets. He was an outspoken supporter of social reform, despite strict censorship laws and harsh penalties for those who broke them. As a satirical polemicist, he frequently made use of his works to criticize intolerance, religious dogma and the French institutions of his day. They like exploring tight dark places, undeterred by mud and whatever may be lurking. Give a caver a task to do, while down in a cave’s depths, and they will stay underground for hours and come back again a few weeks later to do it again. As it turns out, these are the same unique qualities found in some of the Bureau of Land Management’s most remarkable volunteers. The Bureau recently recognized one, in particular, with this year’s BLM Outstanding Volunteer Achievement Award. pages.text: Voting rights laws and constitutional amendments | USAGov Skip to main content Voting rights laws and constitutional amendments Federal laws govern voting rights. Learn about the laws and how they protect your rights and make it easier for you to vote. U.S. election laws date back to Article 1 of the Constitution. This gave states the responsibility of overseeing federal elections. Many constitutional amendments and federal laws protecting voting rights have been passed since then. Constitutional amendments affecting voting rights The 15th Amendment gave African American men the right to vote in 1870. But many weren't able to exercise this right. Some states used literacy tests and other barriers to make it harder to vote. The 19th Amendment , ratified in 1920, gave American women the right to vote. The 24th Amendment , ratified in 1964, eliminated poll taxes. The tax had been used in some states to keep African Americans from voting in federal elections. The 26th Amendment , ratified in 1971, lowered the voting age for all elections to 18. Federal voting rights laws Federal laws passed over the years help protect Americans' right to vote and make it easier for citizens to exercise that right: The Civil Rights Acts created some of the earliest federal protections against discrimination in voting. pages.text: W3C launches second pilot of program to support Open Source projects | 2026 | Blog | W3C Skip to content W3C launches second pilot of program to support Open Source projects Part of Developers Author(s) and publish date By: Ian Jacobs, Strategy Team Published: 27 October 2026 Following a September blog post announcing a first pilot project for a W3C Open Source Program, we are pleased to announce the second pilot project: a polyfill for the WebMCP specification . As the specification explains, “WebMCP API is a new JavaScript interface under incubation that allows web developers to expose their web application functionality as “tools” - JavaScript functions with natural language descriptions and structured schemas that can be invoked by agents , browser’s agents , and assistive technologies.” The polyfill project is designed to increase the interoperability of the API at this early stage of development to enable developers to experiment. If WebMCP successfully transitions to the standardization track (as discussed in the context of the draft charter for an Agentic Web Working Group ) and native implementations provide direct interoperable implementations, the polyfill would gradually be phased out. The initial goals of the WebMCP polyfill project are: To publish the polyfill as an npm package To make progress on two features: lifecycle events and declarative support To monitor the evolution of the WebMCP specification and align code as needed To keep up with Web Platform Tests coverage We are also happy to announce the launch of the W3C Open Source Program Community Group ,

Add to calendar Event details Date: 14 January 2027, 13:00 – 15 January 2027, 18:00 China Standard Time 14 January 2027, 05:00 – 15 January 2027, 10:00 UTC Location: W3C Office in Shenzhen, 2nd Floor, ChangFuJinMao Tower, No. 5, Shihua Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, 518000, China Host: W3C Website: Event page The W3C Web of Things Working Group and W3C China jointly invite you to join us in the W3C Web of Things Open Day in Shenzhen. The event will showcase how WoT technologies work in practice and demonstrate concrete use cases where the WoT approach can be effectively applied to enable interoperable IoT solutions across platforms and ecosystems as well as how physical AI approaches can increase effectiveness. Following the Open Day, participants will have the opportunity to join a W3C Web of Things hands-on day. Through practical examples, the goal is to learn how to launch an IoT project using WoT technologies. Participants are welcome to bring their own IoT devices, experiment with WoT Thing Descriptions, and engage directly with WoT experts to ask questions, exchange experiences, and validate interoperability in practice. pages.description: W3C会長兼暫定CEOのDominique Hazaël-Massieuxによる、先月W3Cで行われた多忙かつ実り多い活動の中から、TPAC 2026・AI @ W3C・アイデンティティ・認証情報の進捗状況・標準化に向けたW3Cインフラのさらなる改善など、注目すべきハイライトや情報を紹介しています。
pages.text: W3C ニュースレター - 2026年10月号 | 2026 | ブログ | W3C コンテンツへスキップ W3C ニュースレター - 2026年10月号 Part of コーポレート 著者と公開日 著者: Dominique Hazaël-Massieux、W3C 暫定CEO 出版日: 2026年11月5日 会員の皆様にお送りしているW3Cニュースレターの公開版です。本ニュースレターでは、先月W3Cで行われた活動の中から注目すべきハイライトや情報を選りすぐり紹介していきます。 今月は、TPACを終えて、AI関連の取り組み、アイデンティティと認証情報関連の取り組み、標準化に向けたW3Cインフラの改善、などに関する最新情報をお届けします。 また各トピックについての質問や、今後のNewsletterで取り上げてほしい内容やフィードバックはいつでもお受けします。 TPAC 2026 W3Cが毎年開催する、W3Cコミュニティが一堂に会する TPAC 2026 が先週の金曜日にダブリンで閉幕しました。会場には500名以上（うち初参加者70名以上）が参加し、250名がリモートで参加しました。1週間の会期中には83のグループミーティング、10時間にわたる92のブレイクアウトセッション、3つのミニワークショップ、ハッカソン、開発者ミートアップ、そして政策立案者を対象とした初の入門セッションが行われました。 W3Cは今回のTPAC欧州版が EU資金によるStandICTプロジェクト の支援を受けたことをありがたく存じます。また、本イベントのスポンサーであるAWS、IgaliaおよびMicrosoft、そしてその他のすべてのTPACスポンサーの皆様に改めて感謝致します。今回のTPACをこれほど実りあるものにするためには皆様の支援が不可欠であったという声を多数参加者からお聞きしました。TPAC 2026では同時進行で議論が行われたため、以下では一部しか紹介できていないかもしれません。ご質問はいつでもお寄せ下さい。 私たちは、 TPACで撮影した写真 も公開しています。ご覧ください。またTPACにご参加いただいた方は、今後の改善のためにもぜひイベントに関する フィードバック をお寄せください。 AI @ W3C 数多くのグループミーティングやブレイクアウトセッションにおいて、急速に変化するAIエコシステムにおけるW3Cの役割について活発な議論が交わされました。 その中でも最も重要なのはおそらく、 新Agentic Web Working Group の必要性と範囲について広範な合意が形成されたことです。 憲章草案の策定 が順調に進められ、 WebMCP仕様 で検討されてきたアイデアを新たな「エージェント向けサイト機能」に関する勧告トラックの成果物へと進展させると明示されました。これはTPAC TPAC Web Machine Learning Community Groupの会議 において、WebMCP仕様自体に関する活発な進展が続いたことを受けたものです。 その姉妹組織である Web Machine Learning Working Group は、 勧告トラックのWeb Neural Network（WebNN）APIに関する作業を継続 し、クライアントサイドでのAIモデル利用を加速させる、この基盤技術の実装と採用に関する報告も行われました。 Web and AI Interest Group では、W3C戦略チームが発表した「 AI時代におけるW3CとWebの現状 」に関する報告書をきっかけとして、 W3CのAI戦略とロードマップ を超える広範なトピックについて議論が行いました。そして分野におけるW3Cの技術的方向性を定める一助となる多くのフィードバックや意見

pages.description: The 20th anniversary of W3C took place on 29 October 2014. An exciting afternoon of insights and discussion about how to keep our 'Commons' strong, followed by a gala dinner.
pages.text: W3C20 Anniversary Symposium Skip to main content W3C20 Anniversary Symposium The Future of the Web Webcast - Recorded 29 October 2014 29 October 2014 Santa Clara Marriott Santa Clara, CA, USA Future of the Web Symposium 3:00–6:00 pm Gala Dinner 7:30–10:00 pm Coming soon: photos and videos. Follow #W3C20 Twitter and Facebook Live Webcast from 3pm-6pm PT on 29 October. Please join me and other global strategists, business leaders and developers for an exciting afternoon of insights and discussion about how to keep our 'Commons' strong, followed by a gala dinner. Tim Berners-Lee Web Inventor and W3C Director The Web is for everyone. It is our virtual “Commons”— shared and made stronger by all. And we need you to make it better. Learn more ↓ In October 1994, Tim Berners-Lee created the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) to lead the Web to its full potential. To mark the anniversary this year, W3C invites the Web community to a 3-hour Symposium on the Future of the Web to discuss how the Web community can: Build a more beautiful Web to enable our creative expression; Extend the Web to the many devices people use to improve their lives; Support trusted communications, secure and private; and Empower all people to use and contribute to the Web, including support for diverse languages and accessibility. The Web turned 25 in 2014 . Join us at W3C20 for a look at the future Web.
